'''International relations'''
*[[Croatia–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] expels five [[Croatia]]n [[diplomat]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-expels-five-croatian-diplomats-retaliatory-move-2022-05-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Foreign relations of Fiji]]
**[[Fiji]] announces that it will become the 14th member of the [[Indo-Pacific Economic Framework for Prosperity]] in order to counter Chinese influence in the Pacific. This comes amid a visit by Chinese foreign minister [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] to [[Kiribati]]. *[[2023 Nigerian presidential election]]
**The [[Federal High Court of Nigeria|Federal High Court]] in [[Yenagoa]] rules that former [[President of Nigeria|President]] [[Goodluck Jonathan]] is allowed to run in the next presidential election, stating that a 2018 amendment prohibiting [[Vice President of Nigeria|vice presidents]] from serving more than one full-term upon succession did not apply to Jonathan. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerias-jonathan-can-contest-presidential-elections-next-year-court-rules-2022-05-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/live/world-61317733 (BBC News)]
